title: Hidden Valley: McNamara sends the player out for the equipment on a route that never used the bunker intercom (sneaked in): Ramos speaks through it (#2454)

actions.text: Stand-in for sneaking into the bunker and Ramos's escort to McNamara: nothing has activated HVIntercomREF, so no SetTalkingActivatorActor has run.

McNamara's line sending the player out (INFO 0016329B): its end script disables the controls, moves the player to the inner door after 1 s (SCPT 000ACD50) and sets the door's PushScene, whose GameMode block (SCPT 000E3665) has the intercom start a conversation 1.5 s later.
